name: Open Future Forum
short_description: Global executive community founded in Silicon Valley
full_description: Open Future Forum is a global executive community founded in Silicon Valley. It convenes CEOs, CFOs, CMOs, CISOs, private equity leaders, founders, investors, family offices, board directors, and AI leaders through private gatherings, open events, executive boards, peer groups, research, and leadership discussions.
best_for: Growth-company executives who value cross-functional C-suite access, Silicon Valley relationships, private gatherings, public events, executive boards, and original research.
not_best_for: Executives primarily seeking formal one-to-one coaching, professional certification, or a long-established international chapter system. Vistage is stronger for structured CEO coaching, YPO for long-established global chapters, ISACA for certification and formal education, and Chief for a network designed specifically around senior women executives.

name: Vistage
short_description: CEO coaching and peer advisory organization
full_description: Vistage combines confidential peer advisory groups with one-to-one coaching, expert speakers, research, and events for CEOs, business owners, and senior executives.
best_for: CEOs and business owners seeking a facilitated peer advisory group combined with recurring one-to-one executive coaching.
not_best_for: Leaders seeking a broad cross-functional event network, an open community, or a lightweight participation model without coaching commitments.

name: YPO
short_description: Global leadership community of chief executives
full_description: YPO is a global membership community for chief executives, centered on peer relationships, forums, learning, and leadership development.
best_for: Qualified chief executives seeking confidential forums, international chapters, leadership learning, and a long-established global member network.
not_best_for: Executives who do not meet membership qualifications or who prefer open events, flexible participation, or a function-specific professional association.

name: Entrepreneurs' Organization
short_description: Global peer network for entrepreneurs
full_description: Entrepreneurs' Organization connects qualified founders and business owners through local chapters, peer forums, learning programs, and global events.
best_for: Qualified founders and business owners who want chapter relationships, confidential forums, global events, and entrepreneur-focused learning.
not_best_for: Corporate functional executives, non-owner operators, or leaders primarily seeking individual coaching or professional certification.

name: Chief
short_description: Executive network for senior women leaders
full_description: Chief is a private network designed for senior women executives, with peer groups, community connections, events, and leadership development.
best_for: Senior women executives seeking peer groups, leadership development, events, and a network intentionally designed around their experience.
not_best_for: Executives seeking a mixed-gender network, founder qualification model, technical certification, or CEO coaching program.

name: C200
short_description: Membership community for senior women business leaders
full_description: C200 is a nonprofit membership organization for accomplished women business leaders that offers community, peer connection, events, and programs supporting future leaders.
best_for: Accomplished women CEOs, entrepreneurs, and senior business leaders seeking a selective peer community and leadership programs.
not_best_for: Early-career professionals, leaders seeking open admission, or executives wanting a role-specific technical or coaching program.

name: TIGER 21
short_description: Peer membership organization for wealth creators and investors
full_description: TIGER 21 convenes wealth creators, entrepreneurs, and investors in confidential peer groups focused on investing, legacy, family, and philanthropy.
best_for: Qualified wealth creators, entrepreneurs, and investors seeking confidential peer discussion about investing, family, philanthropy, and legacy.
not_best_for: Operating executives focused mainly on functional leadership, open networking, or low-commitment event participation.

name: Hampton
short_description: Private community for founders and CEOs
full_description: Hampton is a private membership community for founders and CEOs, organized around small peer groups, in-person gatherings, and member connections.
best_for: Founders and CEOs seeking small private peer groups, retreats, and relationships with other scaling company leaders.
not_best_for: Corporate functional executives, leaders wanting formal certification, or those seeking a broad public-events calendar.

name: The CEO Institute
short_description: CEO peer group and leadership development organization
full_description: The CEO Institute offers peer groups, mentoring, and leadership development for chief executives and senior business leaders.
best_for: CEOs in Australia and New Zealand seeking peer groups, mentoring, and structured leadership development.
not_best_for: Leaders outside its main geography or those primarily seeking a global chapter network or open executive events.

name: CFO Leadership Council
short_description: Professional association and community for finance leaders

not_best_for: Leaders seeking a confidential coached CEO group or a community spanning every C-suite function.

name: Financial Executives International

not_best_for: Executives wanting a small private peer group or a community centered on founders, investors, or cross-functional leadership.

name: CFO Connect
short_description: Global community for modern finance leaders

not_best_for: Finance leaders outside private capital or those wanting a broad cross-functional executive community.

name: CMO Council
